# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Output Contract & Range Mismatch | 227-40, 395-36, 402-43, 560-12 | Agent misinterprets answer positions or truncates data to fit the range. | BEHAVIORAL | Output Contract / Ordered Procedure |
| 2 | Logic & Interpretation Errors | 39046, 9569 | Hardcoded ranges and incorrect assumptions about sheet structure. | BEHAVIORAL | Ordered Procedure (Inspect) |
| 3 | Color Detection Gap | 267-18 | Reliance on simple hex codes for cell colors, ignoring Theme/Tint. | CAPABILITY-GAP | Technical Guidance |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output Contract & Range Mismatch | Ordered Procedure | prompt.md | Added "Cross-Check" step to verify coordinates against literal instructions. | Yes |
| Output Contract & Range Mismatch | Tighten Output Contract | task_template.md | Explicitly forbid truncation of data to fit the answer range. | Yes |
| Logic & Interpretation Errors | Ordered Procedure | prompt.md | Mandated dynamic range detection in "Inspect" step instead of hardcoding. | Yes |
| Color Detection Gap | Technical Guidance | prompt.md | Provided robust method for detecting cell colors using theme and rgb. | Yes |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 560-12: wrote to I2 instead of I3 → "Cross-Check" step now forces verification against "put from I3".
- 402-43, 227-40: truncated data to fit range → "do not truncate the data unless explicitly told to" prevents this.
- 9569: hardcoded range A-AN → "Determine the dynamic ranges... instead of hardcoding indices" prevents this.
- 267-18: failed to find yellow cells → "check both fill.start_color.rgb and fill.start_color.theme" enables correct detection.

## Process & features used
- Used a diagnostic subagent to cluster failures.
- Applied multiple improvement types: Ordered Procedure, Output Contract, and Technical Guidance.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Use of `openpyxl` for writing to preserve formatting.
- Left join/merge for lookups.
- Mandatory verification checklist.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- None.
